title:
Base type for all components that process unstructured data.

Each component performs a specific processing step on input data,
e.g. parsing input files or chunking parsed documents

When used sequentially in a {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Processor}, the output of one
component should be in a format that can be handled by the next component and the output of the last component must
be in the format of a list of {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Processor.OutputChunk}.
name: GenaiCore.Unstructured.ProcessorComponent
